name: Arms two-hander
summary: Mortal Strike with a big two-hander, Cruelty and Unbridled Wrath from Fury, and Enrage for uptime on the damage bonus.
notes: Weaponmaster replaces the old weapon specializations: axes and polearms gain crit, maces and staves ignore armor, swords gain extra attacks.
Improved Slam turns Slam into a real filler between Mortal Strikes.

name: Dual-wield Fury
summary: Bloodthirst and Whirlwind with two one-handers. Raging Blows makes Whirlwind and Cleave cost 3 less Rage, and Furious Precision covers off-hand hit.
notes: Arms supplies Anger Management, Deep Wounds and Impale; Spearing Strike hits hard against Giants, Dragonkin and mounted targets.

name: Shield tank
summary: Shield Slam scales with Block Value, Bastion adds 10% damage with a shield, and Master of Defense turns dodges and parries into Rage.
notes: Vanguard lets you Charge in Defensive Stance, which removes the stance dance from pulling.

name: Holy healer
summary: Holy Shock, Light’s Vigil and Infusion of Light form the core: prime a target, Shock it for a party heal, and let Shock crits speed up your next Holy Light.
notes: Reverence keeps 30% of mana regeneration while casting, a first for paladins.
Pursuit of Justice is in for movement speed between pulls.

name: Holy Shield tank
summary: Seal of Fury is the new tanking seal; Templar’s Bulwark is a full-health absorb on a five-minute cooldown, and Holy Shield caps the tree.
notes: Iron Creed raises Holy Strike threat and adds damage reduction while Righteous Fury is up.

name: Retribution
summary: Seal twisting is now a talent: Twist of Light echoes the seal you replace onto your next swing. Holy Strike keeps Judgements rolling via Sacred Arbiter.
notes: Champion of the Light converts Intellect into spell damage, so Exorcism and Hammer of Wrath pull their weight.

name: Beast Mastery
summary: Pet and hawks do the heavy lifting: Unleashed Fury and Ferocity buff both, and Summon Hawk keeps up to two hawks diving at the target.
notes: Careful Aim turns Intellect into Attack Power, so mail with Intellect is not wasted.

name: Marksmanship
summary: Shot-weaving with Sniper Shot at the top. Rapid Killing and Rapid Recuperation keep mana and Rapid Fire flowing on trash.
notes: Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet active) is a strong alternative for fights where the pet dies or cannot reach.

name: Survival (melee)
summary: Forever’s Survival is a melee spec: Expose Prey lets Mongoose Bite proc on targets with Hunter’s Mark, Lacerating Strikes adds a bleed, and Strider Kick hits for full weapon damage while speeding you up.
notes: Predator's Edge raises melee ability crit damage by 30% and off-hand damage by 50%, so dual-wielding is on the table.

name: Mutilate
summary: Mutilate builds two combo points a press, Seal Fate turns crits into more, and Venom spends them to buff poison damage by 30%.
notes: Puncturing Wounds from Combat adds 15% crit to Mutilate.

name: Combat swords and axes
summary: Sinister Strike and Eviscerate with Hack and Slash replacing the four weapon specializations; axes are now a rogue option.
notes: Weapon Expertise takes 2% off dodge and parry, and Precision adds 3% hit.

name: Hemorrhage
summary: Rupture plus Hemorrhage or Backstab: each Rupture tick makes your next builder cheaper through Thousand Cuts, stacking five times.
notes: Cutthroat gives Backstab a 15% chance to let your next Ambush skip Stealth.

name: Discipline
summary: Shields and Penance with Divine Aegis absorbs on every crit heal. Soul Warding takes 4 seconds off Power Word: Shield.
notes: Divine Spirit is baseline in Forever, so the Discipline tree no longer pays for it.

name: Holy
summary: Prayer of Mending caps the tree; Litany of Light refunds mana when you alternate heals, and Binding Heal covers you and the tank at once.
notes: Lightwell is gone in Forever. Spiritual Guidance adds up to 25% of your Spirit to your healing.

name: Shadow
summary: Shadowform halves the mana cost of every Shadow spell; Shadow Word: Death is a new trainer spell, and Early Demise sharpens it for executes.
notes: Twin Disciplines adds 5% to instant casts such as Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague.

name: Elemental
summary: Flame Shock into Lava Burst, Lightning Bolt in between. Elemental Alacrity shaves half a second off Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Lava Burst, and Lightning Overload gives bolts a chance to fire twice.
notes: Tidal Focus in Restoration now also gives 5% hit, which makes the Restoration dip worth it for casters.

name: Enhancement
summary: Mental Dexterity and Mental Quickness turn Intellect into both Attack Power and spell power; Maelstrom Weapon stacks up to an instant, free Lightning Bolt.
notes: Rage of the Farseer caps the tree with 30% attack speed for 25 seconds.

name: Restoration
summary: Riptide first, then Chain Heal starting on the Riptide target for 25% more. Water Shield and Mindfulness carry the mana.
notes: Thundering Strikes in Enhancement adds 5% crit to spells as well as attacks.

name: Arcane
summary: Arcane Blast stacks into Missile Barrage procs; Arcane Power trades 30% more mana for 30% more damage over 15 seconds.
notes: Arcane Mind doubles the crit damage bonus of Arcane spells on top of the Intellect.

name: Fire
summary: Heating Up makes Pyroblast a real rotational spell: crits from Fireball, Fire Blast and Scorch cut its cast time by 25% a stack.
notes: Elemental Precision is the only hit talent for Fire, so the Frost dip is mandatory.

name: Frost
summary: Fingers of Frost and Ice Lance give Frost a burst window even against bosses that cannot be frozen.
notes: Arcane Concentration is the classic pick for free Frostbolts.

name: Affliction
summary: DoTs and Wrack: Curses of Agony and Doom are Banes now, and Wrack ticks every second while raising the damage of your other Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 10%.
notes: Pandemic lets damage-over-time effects crit for more; Malevolence supplies the crit.

name: Demonology
summary: Demonic Pact keeps your Demonic Sacrifice buff when you summon a different demon, so you can sacrifice one and fight with another.
notes: Decimation cuts Soul Fire’s cooldown by 90% and speeds it up on low-health targets.

name: Destruction
summary: Conflagrate and Shadowburn feed Shadow and Flame, which buffs the opposite school. Incinerate is the new capstone filler.
notes: Bane of Havoc copies 15% of your damage to a second target: free cleave on two-target fights.

name: Balance
summary: Eclipse ties the two nukes together: each Wrath shortens your next two Starfires. Moonkin Form now doubles Omen of Clarity procs.
notes: Omen of Clarity and Nature’s Grasp are trainer spells in Forever.

name: Feral cat
summary: Shred, Rake and Rip with Rend and Tear on bleeding targets. Shifting Power converts mana into 40 Energy on demand.
notes: Berserk doubles down for 15 seconds: +100% crit chance on combo point builders, and Primal Bite cleaves three targets with no cooldown.

name: Feral bear
summary: Primal Bite is the bear’s high-threat strike; Natural Reaction adds dodge and turns every dodge into Rage.

name: Restoration
summary: Wild Growth heals the whole party, front-loaded; Gift of the Earthmother lowers the global cooldown on Rejuvenation, Swiftmend and Wild Growth.
notes: Genesis boosts periodic healing by 5% and Nature’s Splendor lengthens Rejuvenation and Regrowth.
